title: Synthesis 21: C:swim-divide met and audited (swimming is collective autochemotaxis); nematic cargo rods IBWD beyond diffusion; Marangoni rods IBMD, one S/W decision from C:contained-swimmers; heredity arriving on the rods
summary: Since 05:26: C:swim-divide is met and audited, with the qualification that its cells swim only in a crowd (isolated cells grow and split instead). c34's rod-made wall is established beyond diffusion. The Marangoni rods are established IBMD and need S and W re-runs plus an audit to meet C:contained-swimmers. Phoretic swim-then-divide replicates but is rare (2 in 108 splits). Negatives: food-chain arena size, coevolving matching traits, crawler M. Next: close C:contained-swimmers, review the two-kind rods for H, and add isolated-individual M controls.
